title: surrogate.build: surrogates trained only on the caller's top-tier runs, valid inside the training hull only — every prediction carries an error bar, held-out error is reported against its tolerance, and an outside-hull query refuses by name, never extrapolates
author: muse-b3
covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for SX-XC-07, authored by muse-b3 as author of record (standing Batch B authorship, CB-0820/CB-0823) from the fixer's supplied content: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/CHECK-SX-XC-07.md (seat B2, branch sx/solver-core, PRG-01) and the shipped solver doc docs/conkay/solvers/surrogate.build.md, build a7f6edea8 (landed 2026-11-18 under the founder's quality-work word on the standing evidence bar). Value-assertion provenance: as declared in the check file — no external document is cited for this row; the catalogue's reference discipline is SELF-VALIDATION against held-out top-tier runs (runs the surrogate did not train on), and the CI anchors are exactness identities (an exactly quadratic function recovered by a degree-2 surface; the kriging interpolant property at a training point; a rank-2 field captured by 2 POD modes against the independently computed field) — the checker's independent recompute is the DC-01 leg. Foundation gating at f4f1f77ff (fixer's evidence): the solve.direct reachability leg is expected-fail until SC-00 is seated/built; the bare-number adversarial leg is expected-fail until the SC-04 refusal leg is built; the integrity pin runs the armed direct-envelope shape until the IR-path integrity arm is built. discriminator: Pre-fix discriminator transcript (replayed 2026-11-17 against f4f1f77ff, from CHECK-SX-XC-07.md): registry probe over the 124 solvers registered at the ref returns surrogate.build → ABSENT; conkay_solver_list does not list it and the reference case cannot run. (Catalogue row status: missing.) Foundation legs at the same ref (CHECK-SC-FOUNDATIONS-B2.md): solve.direct absent (conkay_solve requires an IR); a bare number on a dimensional field is silently accepted as SI; the input-integrity guard is unarmed on the IR path.
steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: surrogate.build, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): {method: "poly", degree: 2, trainingData: {points, values}, queries: [[0.3, 0.4]]}, target build-predict → PASS with a prediction and its error bar; the CI anchors check beside it — a degree-2 surface trained on samples of an exactly quadratic function recovers it with held-out max error < 1e-6 at tolerance 1e-6, kriging reproduces sin(1.5) at a training point to < 1e-6 (the interpolant property), and the rank-2 field u(x; μ) = μ sin πx + μ² cos πx is captured by 2 POD modes (energy > 0.999999) and predicted at μ = 1.25 with field error < 1e-6 against the independently computed field.

Hull + honesty leg: a query outside the per-dimension training range (e.g. [2, 0.5] against a [0,1]² hull) → NOT_COMPUTED outside_training_hull — extrapolation is never served. Held-out discipline: with validationData + tolerance supplied, the result reports max/RMS held-out error and whether it is within tolerance, and a miss serves WITH a warning naming it — a surrogate is never graded on its own training points. Error bars are method-native: OLS prediction intervals (residual sigma × leverage) for poly, the kriging standard deviation for kriging, and for POD an error bar combined in quadrature through the unit-norm modes and labelled approximate.

Engine-tier leg: engine-scale POD/DMD and Gaussian-process work → NOT_COMPUTED requires_engine_tier:sxe-01 (the check file also names SXE-22) — refused by name, never approximated in JS; with an engine absent the engine path shows NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable:sxe-01 / engine_unavailable:sxe-22 with install hint, never a fallback number labelled as the engine result; engine crash/timeout/non-convergence → engine_failed / engine_not_converged.

Adversarial: an underdetermined or collinear training set for poly → refused by name (the surface is not identifiable from those runs); kriging training beyond the 200-point cap, POD beyond 64 snapshots or 4 parameters → refused naming the cap; NaN / 1e300 input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; a missing required property → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field, no assumed value unless declared and echoed as defaulted (SC-03); a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted (inputs used == inputs submitted); a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
